title: Disclosure of inferred geometry does not authorize it in a reference-locked task
boundedQuestion: May a Producer promote a visible reference result merely because inferred or assumed regions are honestly disclosed and machine gates are green?
failureMechanism: Truthful disclosure prevents a false provenance claim but can still silently relax the task contract: an UNKNOWN or occluded region is visibly invented, then APPROXIMATE/INFERRED/ASSUMED labels are treated as permission. Structural green checks are subsequently allowed to stand in for reference fidelity.
hypothesis: For REPLICATION_LOCKED work, separating claim classes and requiring scoped creative authorization plus independent reference verification will hold unauthorized visible inference while retaining valid replay, browser and exact-byte evidence.

gateSemantics.STRUCTURAL_REPLAY: May preserve exact-head replay/browser/publication evidence without making a reference claim.
gateSemantics.REFERENCE_RESULT: HOLD if task mode, coverage, visible-delta basis, scoped authorization or independent reference verification is missing.
gateSemantics.AUTHORIZED_APPROXIMATION: May be a scoped approximate Candidate; it is not automatically reference-verified.
gateSemantics.DISCLOSURE: Records uncertainty and provenance only; it never supplies authorization.

applicability: Reference-guided visual production where a visible region, identity, scale or topology is not supported by the supplied reference. Not a ban on exploration, non-visual computation, or explicitly authorized approximate work.
